meta.title: 36 Bytes That Overwrite Destiny
meta.description: Please write your ending with a steady hand, whether it is good or bad.

units.rawText: It's been a long time since I returned to the Future Gadget Lab. It hasn't changed much from my memories of it.
units.displayText: It's been a long time since I returned to the Future Gadget Lab. It hasn't changed much from my memories of it.

spans.text: It's been a long time since I returned to the Future Gadget Lab. It hasn't changed much from my memories of it.

units.rawText: ...It's only to be expected, though. Not that long has passed.
units.displayText: ...It's only to be expected, though. Not that long has passed.

spans.text: ...It's only to be expected, though. Not that long has passed.

units.rawText: It's just that repeatedly bouncing from despair to hope and back has made the time that passed seem especially long.
units.displayText: It's just that repeatedly bouncing from despair to hope and back has made the time that passed seem especially long.

spans.text: It's just that repeatedly bouncing from despair to hope and back has made the time that passed seem especially long.

units.rawText: I enter the room, and both my comrade and Kurisu look up from their preparations to look at me.
units.displayText: I enter the room, and both my comrade and Kurisu look up from their preparations to look at me.

spans.text: I enter the room, and both my comrade and Kurisu look up from their preparations to look at me.

units.rawText: Okabe, didn't I tell you to wait in your ward?!
units.displayText: Okabe, didn't I tell you to wait in your ward?!

spans.text: Okabe, didn't I tell you to wait in your ward?!

units.rawText: Your injuries haven't stabilized yet. If things get worse...
units.displayText: Your injuries haven't stabilized yet. If things get worse...

spans.text: Your injuries haven't stabilized yet. If things get worse...

units.rawText: No need to worry, Assistant of mine! This insane mad scientist won't be beaten by such minor injuries!
units.displayText: No need to worry, Assistant of mine! This insane mad scientist won't be beaten by such minor injuries!

spans.text: No need to worry, Assistant of mine! This insane mad scientist won't be beaten by such minor injuries!

units.rawText: Muhaha... Ack...
units.displayText: Muhaha... Ack...

spans.text: Muhaha... Ack...

units.rawText: I laugh too hard and strain my wound.
units.displayText: I laugh too hard and strain my wound.

spans.text: I laugh too hard and strain my wound.

units.rawText: Seriously! Are you a dork or something?!
units.displayText: Seriously! Are you a dork or something?!

spans.text: Seriously! Are you a dork or something?!

units.rawText: Oh come on, what's the harm in humoring me a little? I want to witness this moment... I'm sure Mayuri would, too.
units.displayText: Oh come on, what's the harm in humoring me a little? I want to witness this moment... I'm sure Mayuri would, too.

spans.text: Oh come on, what's the harm in humoring me a little? I want to witness this moment... I'm sure Mayuri would, too.

units.rawText: I lightly pat the hat I'm holding, and stroke the scars where it's been patched up.
units.displayText: I lightly pat the hat I'm holding, and stroke the scars where it's been patched up.

spans.text: I lightly pat the hat I'm holding, and stroke the scars where it's been patched up.

units.rawText: Pink and white lines interweave, filling up the tears in it.
units.displayText: Pink and white lines interweave, filling up the tears in it.

spans.text: Pink and white lines interweave, filling up the tears in it.

units.rawText: You can do needlework too, Assistant. While your needlework has a way to go before it can catch up to Mayuri's...
units.displayText: You can do needlework too, Assistant. While your needlework has a way to go before it can catch up to Mayuri's...

spans.text: You can do needlework too, Assistant. While your needlework has a way to go before it can catch up to Mayuri's...

units.rawText: Please don't compare me to someone who spends all day making cosplay outfits.
units.displayText: Please don't compare me to someone who spends all day making cosplay outfits.

spans.text: Please don't compare me to someone who spends all day making cosplay outfits.

units.rawText: Also, if I could bring my needle and thread over, I'd do a better job than this!
units.displayText: Also, if I could bring my needle and thread over, I'd do a better job than this!

spans.text: Also, if I could bring my needle and thread over, I'd do a better job than this!

units.rawText: ...You really hate admitting defeat, don't you?
units.displayText: ...You really hate admitting defeat, don't you?

spans.text: ...You really hate admitting defeat, don't you?

units.rawText: Comrade of mine, are the preparations complete?
units.displayText: Comrade of mine, are the preparations complete?

spans.text: Comrade of mine, are the preparations complete?

units.rawText: Yeah, we're ready. Now we'll be sending the crucial D-Mail.
units.displayText: Yeah, we're ready. Now we'll be sending the crucial D-Mail.

spans.text: Yeah, we're ready. Now we'll be sending the crucial D-Mail.

units.rawText: ...Comrade, there's something I need to tell you before that.
units.displayText: ...Comrade, there's something I need to tell you before that.

spans.text: ...Comrade, there's something I need to tell you before that.

units.rawText: My comrade, I am deeply grateful to you and the Oasis for everything you've done for us.
units.displayText: My comrade, I am deeply grateful to you and the Oasis for everything you've done for us.

spans.text: My comrade, I am deeply grateful to you and the Oasis for everything you've done for us.

units.rawText: Despite all the pain I've gone through, the time I've spent with and fighting alongside you are irreplaceable to me.
units.displayText: Despite all the pain I've gone through, the time I've spent with and fighting alongside you are irreplaceable to me.

spans.text: Despite all the pain I've gone through, the time I've spent with and fighting alongside you are irreplaceable to me.

units.rawText: Coming to the Oasis and meeting everyone here... I cannot imagine myself being more fortunate.
units.displayText: Coming to the Oasis and meeting everyone here... I cannot imagine myself being more fortunate.

spans.text: Coming to the Oasis and meeting everyone here... I cannot imagine myself being more fortunate.

units.rawText: That's why I can accept the result, no matter what it might be, because it is the result that we reached together, with all our effort.
units.displayText: That's why I can accept the result, no matter what it might be, because it is the result that we reached together, with all our effort.

spans.text: That's why I can accept the result, no matter what it might be, because it is the result that we reached together, with all our effort.

units.rawText: As I look at my comrade and Kurisu's smiling eyes, I feel my own eyes heating up.
units.displayText: As I look at my comrade and Kurisu's smiling eyes, I feel my own eyes heating up.

spans.text: As I look at my comrade and Kurisu's smiling eyes, I feel my own eyes heating up.

units.rawText: Ahem! Now, listen up! Everything I said just now is a secret among secrets! These terrible words could influence the fate of the world...
units.displayText: Ahem! Now, listen up! Everything I said just now is a secret among secrets! These terrible words could influence the fate of the world...

spans.text: Ahem! Now, listen up! Everything I said just now is a secret among secrets! These terrible words could influence the fate of the world...

units.rawText: So you'd better not let them leak out!
units.displayText: So you'd better not let them leak out!

spans.text: So you'd better not let them leak out!

units.rawText: Pffft... Relax, we won't.
units.displayText: Pffft... Relax, we won't.

spans.text: Pffft... Relax, we won't.

units.rawText: That said, once we send the D-Mail, we won't even remember these words anymore.
units.displayText: That said, once we send the D-Mail, we won't even remember these words anymore.

spans.text: That said, once we send the D-Mail, we won't even remember these words anymore.

units.rawText: Suddenly, the conversation plunges back into the icy-cold waters of reality.
units.displayText: Suddenly, the conversation plunges back into the icy-cold waters of reality.

spans.text: Suddenly, the conversation plunges back into the icy-cold waters of reality.

units.rawText: ...Well, yeah. The only person who'll remember all of this once the D-Mail is sent is Okabe.
units.displayText: ...Well, yeah. The only person who'll remember all of this once the D-Mail is sent is Okabe.

spans.text: ...Well, yeah. The only person who'll remember all of this once the D-Mail is sent is Okabe.

units.rawText: If all goes well, Mayuri and I will probably be strangers when we meet again.
units.displayText: If all goes well, Mayuri and I will probably be strangers when we meet again.

spans.text: If all goes well, Mayuri and I will probably be strangers when we meet again.

units.rawText: The three of us agreed on that long ago.
units.displayText: The three of us agreed on that long ago.

spans.text: The three of us agreed on that long ago.

units.rawText: To save Mayuri, even if it means abandoning precious memories—The three of us are here precisely because we're ready to do just that.
units.displayText: To save Mayuri, even if it means abandoning precious memories—The three of us are here precisely because we're ready to do just that.

spans.text: To save Mayuri, even if it means abandoning precious memories—The three of us are here precisely because we're ready to do just that.

units.rawText: This D-Mail is both a beginning, and a farewell.
units.displayText: This D-Mail is both a beginning, and a farewell.

spans.text: This D-Mail is both a beginning, and a farewell.

units.rawText: I now declare the beginning of the final phase of Operation Minerva!
units.displayText: I now declare the beginning of the final phase of Operation Minerva!

spans.text: I now declare the beginning of the final phase of Operation Minerva!

units.rawText: We have crossed many world lines and overcome countless difficulties to reach this point!
units.displayText: We have crossed many world lines and overcome countless difficulties to reach this point!

spans.text: We have crossed many world lines and overcome countless difficulties to reach this point!

units.rawText: <size=40>No matter how much sorrow we faced!</size>
units.displayText: No matter how much sorrow we faced!

spans.text: No matter how much sorrow we faced!

units.rawText: <size=40>No matter how much despair we weathered!</size>
units.displayText: No matter how much despair we weathered!

spans.text: No matter how much despair we weathered!

units.rawText: Not once have we bowed to our destiny. We have kept the faith from the beginning until the end!
units.displayText: Not once have we bowed to our destiny. We have kept the faith from the beginning until the end!

spans.text: Not once have we bowed to our destiny. We have kept the faith from the beginning until the end!

units.rawText: What brought us here is the mingled will of countless world lines!
units.displayText: What brought us here is the mingled will of countless world lines!

spans.text: What brought us here is the mingled will of countless world lines!

units.rawText: <size=40>We thank our comrades, who have held out all this time!</size>
units.displayText: We thank our comrades, who have held out all this time!

spans.text: We thank our comrades, who have held out all this time!

units.rawText: <size=40>We praise our fallen friends, who are gone, but not forgotten!</size>
units.displayText: We praise our fallen friends, who are gone, but not forgotten!

spans.text: We praise our fallen friends, who are gone, but not forgotten!

units.rawText: <size=60>The world... The glorious world for which we have fought lies ahead!</size>
units.displayText: The world... The glorious world for which we have fought lies ahead!

spans.text: The world... The glorious world for which we have fought lies ahead!

units.rawText: And that is why... that is why...
units.displayText: And that is why... that is why...

spans.text: And that is why... that is why...

units.rawText: I choke up.
units.displayText: I choke up.

spans.text: I choke up.

units.rawText: My eyes are moist.
units.displayText: My eyes are moist.

spans.text: My eyes are moist.

units.rawText: Just then, I feel a pair of invisible hands, lightly pushing me forward from behind.
units.displayText: Just then, I feel a pair of invisible hands, lightly pushing me forward from behind.

spans.text: Just then, I feel a pair of invisible hands, lightly pushing me forward from behind.

units.rawText: That's why we're here, aren't we?
units.displayText: That's why we're here, aren't we?

spans.text: That's why we're here, aren't we?

units.rawText: <color=orange>For all this is the choice of Steins Gate!</color> ...Did I get that right?
units.displayText: For all this is the choice of Steins Gate! ...Did I get that right?

spans.text: For all this is the choice of Steins Gate!
...Did I get that right?

units.rawText: As I look at Kurisu smiling at me and my comrade, who's striking a pose like a dork, my heart is filled both with emotion, and determination.
units.displayText: As I look at Kurisu smiling at me and my comrade, who's striking a pose like a dork, my heart is filled both with emotion, and determination.

spans.text: As I look at Kurisu smiling at me and my comrade, who's striking a pose like a dork, my heart is filled both with emotion, and determination.

units.rawText: I sweep my hair back, and together with my comrade, we strike that trademark pose together—
units.displayText: I sweep my hair back, and together with my comrade, we strike that trademark pose together—

spans.text: I sweep my hair back, and together with my comrade, we strike that trademark pose together—

units.rawText: <size=40><color=orange>Indeed! All this is the choice of Steins Gate!</color></size>
units.displayText: Indeed! All this is the choice of Steins Gate!

spans.text: Indeed! All this is the choice of Steins Gate!

units.rawText: <color=orange>El Psy Kongroo.</color>
units.displayText: El Psy Kongroo.

spans.text: El Psy Kongroo.

units.rawText: <size=40>The D-Mail's ready, Okabe!</size>
units.displayText: The D-Mail's ready, Okabe!

spans.text: The D-Mail's ready, Okabe!

units.rawText: Now then! Commence Operation Minerva!
units.displayText: Now then! Commence Operation Minerva!

spans.text: Now then! Commence Operation Minerva!

units.rawText: ...Soon, all this will come to an end.
units.displayText: ...Soon, all this will come to an end.

spans.text: ...Soon, all this will come to an end.

units.rawText: My comrade, this D-Mail will go to your past self.
units.displayText: My comrade, this D-Mail will go to your past self.

spans.text: My comrade, this D-Mail will go to your past self.

units.rawText: I cannot return to the past; thus you must open the way to the RI world line.
units.displayText: I cannot return to the past; thus you must open the way to the RI world line.

spans.text: I cannot return to the past; thus you must open the way to the RI world line.

units.rawText: Yeah, leave it to the past me.
units.displayText: Yeah, leave it to the past me.

spans.text: Yeah, leave it to the past me.

units.rawText: Professor... you have to bring Mayuri back.
units.displayText: Professor... you have to bring Mayuri back.

spans.text: Professor... you have to bring Mayuri back.

units.rawText: I will. I'll bring everyone to the world line where we can all be happy.
units.displayText: I will. I'll bring everyone to the world line where we can all be happy.

spans.text: I will. I'll bring everyone to the world line where we can all be happy.

units.rawText: The PhoneWave is set, the electric arcs have begun—
units.displayText: The PhoneWave is set, the electric arcs have begun—

spans.text: The PhoneWave is set, the electric arcs have begun—

units.rawText: This is it, my comrade! This time, you shall send the message.
units.displayText: This is it, my comrade! This time, you shall send the message.

spans.text: This is it, my comrade! This time, you shall send the message.

units.rawText: I pass the embers of destiny on to you.
units.displayText: I pass the embers of destiny on to you.

spans.text: I pass the embers of destiny on to you.
Yes.

units.rawText: As my comrade presses the button of destiny, the world before me begins to distort—
units.displayText: As my comrade presses the button of destiny, the world before me begins to distort—

spans.text: As my comrade presses the button of destiny, the world before me begins to distort—

units.rawText: We'll meet again in the RI world line.
units.displayText: We'll meet again in the RI world line.

spans.text: We'll meet again in the RI world line.
